description:
[FREE] SolvScore REPGATE: map an agent's trust score to its live rate-limit tier.
Returns trust_score, rate_limit_tier (GOLD/TRUSTED/STANDARD/UNTRUSTED/BLOCKED),
requests_per_hour, used_last_hour, remaining, resets_in_seconds and whether the
agent clears the 85-trust underwriting threshold. Accepts name, slug or id.
Reputation-gated throughput, live on agentworld.me/rep-gate/.
name: solvscore_repgate
